query:
-- Dar baixa completa na Parcela 1 (R$ 900)
UPDATE bpo_charges 
SET status = 'receivedInCash', 
    amount_paid = 900.00, 
    paid_date = '2026-04-16',
    description = CONCAT(description, ' [Baixa manual: quitado via PIX #30002 de R$ 1.400,00 em 16/04/2026]')
WHERE id = 226 AND client_name LIKE '%MHAMED%' AND status = 'overdue';

-- Aplicar pagamento parcial na Parcela 2 (R$ 500 dos R$ 900 restantes)
UPDATE bpo_charges 
SET status = 'partiallyPaid', 
    amount_paid = 500.00, 
    paid_date = '2026-04-16',
    description = CONCAT(description, ' [Pagamento parcial: R$ 500,00 via PIX #30002 de R$ 1.400,00 em 16/04/2026]')
WHERE id = 225 AND client_name LIKE '%MHAMED%' AND status = 'overdue'
